headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-3 on the top plays · Season: 55-224

entries.headline: Munetaka Murakami stayed in the yard
entries.story: Munetaka Murakami went 1-for-3 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against AJ Blubaugh and the Houston Astros. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Ben Rice connected at +478
entries.story: Ben Rice cashed. Facing Payton Tolle, he went deep in the 5th in his 3rd at bat. The call: "Ben Rice homers (1) on a fly ball to center field." He added another later in the game. Final line: 4-for-5.

entries.headline: Wilyer Abreu stayed in the yard
entries.story: Wilyer Abreu went 1-for-3 against Cam Schlittler and the New York Yankees. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Giancarlo Stanton did not appear
entries.story: Giancarlo Stanton was scratched or never got in the game, so the pick carries over as a no-action.
